correctness.rationale: Boolean evaluation gives F³=S F and im F precisely the cyclic 101-avoiding words; on im F, F²=S and hence every state is recurrent at time 0 or 1. For even m fixed points reduce to spatial period gcd(n,m/2), and for odd m the fixed equation at reduced odd circumference is equivalent to an independent dominating subset of one cyclic graph (Perrin count). Möbius inversion counts primitive temporal orbits. Characteristic polynomials of the two de Bruijn transfers yield all lengths and spectral growth. Independent full-state enumeration confirmed 126 fixed-time tests for n=3..11. The proof, not these samples, establishes n>=3 and every m>=1.
